kindergarten.title: Kindergarten & Early Years School
kindergarten.article:
Kindergarten & Early Years School

Nurturing Wonder, Curiosity, and Potential (Ages 3–6)

Welcome to the Kindergarten at Laiser Hill Academy—a vibrant, joyful space designed specifically for children aged 3 to 6 years. Here, learning is a magical journey of discovery, play, and growth. We believe that these early years lay the groundwork for a lifetime of confidence, character, and academic success.

primary.title: Primary & Junior School
primary.article:
Primary & Junior School

Building All-Round Competencies for Future Leaders (Ages 6–14)

At Laiser Hill Academy, our Primary and Junior School offers a dynamic educational environment where young learners transition seamlessly from pre-school into a world of expanded knowledge, skill acquisition, and personal growth. We provide an enriching curriculum designed to cultivate curious, confident, and well-rounded individuals ready to take on global challenges.

senior.title: Senior School
senior.article:
Senior School

Developing Visionary Leaders, Scholars, and Champions

Welcome to Laiser Hill Academy Senior School—a premier center for academic rigor, character development, and holistic excellence. Designed for young men and women preparing for higher education and global careers, our Senior School offers a supportive, high-performing environment that fosters leadership, critical thinking, and self-reliance.

international.title: International School
international.article:
Laiser Hill International School

Globally Recognized Excellence: British Curriculum (Pearson Edexcel)

Welcome to Laiser Hill International School, where global academic standards meet individual student success. Following the prestigious British International Curriculum, our school is fully accredited by Pearson Edexcel to administer official international examinations for both IGCSE and International Advanced Level (IAL) qualifications.

admission.title: Admissions
admission.article:
Admissions Process

Joining the Laiser Hill Academy Family

At Laiser Hill Academy, we strive to make our admissions journey clear, supportive, and welcoming for every prospective family. Whether you are seeking entry into our Kindergarten, Primary, Junior School, Senior School (CBC & 8-4-4), or International School (Pearson Edexcel IGCSE & A-Levels), our structured process ensures a smooth transition for your child.



1.1. Initial Enquiry: Get in touch.

Reach out to our admissions office via phone, whatsapp, email, or by filling out our online enquiry form. Our team will provide initial details regarding class availability, curriculum pathways, and fee structures.



2.2. Campus Visit & Tour: Experience our grounds.

We invite parents and students to visit our expansive campus along the Nairobi–Magadi Highway. Take a guided tour of our modern ICT and science labs, vast sporting facilities, comfortable dormitories, and vibrant classrooms to experience our learning environment firsthand.



3.3. Learner Assessment & Interview: Oral & written evaluation.

To ensure proper placement and identify your child's academic needs, prospective students undertake a friendly entrance assessment (covering written and/or oral components, depending on the age group and curriculum entry level).



4.4. Official Offer Letter: Securing your place.

Upon successful completion of the assessment, our admissions committee issues a formal Letter of Offer, outlining the allocated class, curriculum path, and fee guidelines.



5.5. Complete Admission Documentation: Finalizing details.

Fill out the comprehensive school admission form, providing necessary student records, medical history, emergency contact details, and previous academic transcripts.



6.6. Fee Payment: Account confirmation.

Complete payment of required admission fees and tuition according to the payment structure outlined in your offer package.



7.7. Admission & Orientation: Welcome to Laiser Hill!.

The student is officially enrolled! We welcome your child on their first day with a comprehensive orientation session to introduce them to their teachers, classmates, and campus routines as they embark on their journey To Greater Heights.
